objective_terms.group_policy: full original groups preserved; whitening deferred to G2

timings.cold_cuda_note: First CUDA event span may include lazy module loading / host launch delay; reported separately from warm kernel time.
timings.timing_boundary: Native call, entire 101-frame batch; CPU serial same-source reference. CUDA wall includes kernel and D2H. Python copies/render/IO excluded.

first_validated_cuda_invocation.source: First successful real-window run recorded in this session before the final repeat; not included in warm statistics.

timings.cuda_cold_note: cuda_cold is the first evaluation in the final process; earlier successful invocation was 533.575 ms. Driver/module cache can make new-process startup differ.

memory.note: cudaMemGetInfo includes device-global changes, not exclusive process peak; owned buffers are exact. Process working set includes preparation and driver.

limitations: Only current shared curling contour factors have CUDA support.
Frozen historical stations are evaluated against current geometry; residual size is not a new fit or point-quality acceptance.
No Jacobian, whitening, block accumulation, parameter update or nonlinear optimizer executed.
